description: Compare 2-5 cryptocurrencies side by side. Shows price, 24-hour change, market cap, volume, and rank for each coin in a comparison table. Use this for 'compare bitcoin and ethereum', 'BTC vs ETH vs SOL', 'which is bigger bitcoin or ethereum?', 'compare top cryptos', 'crypto head to head', or any multi-coin comparison question.

coins.description: Coin names or tickers, 2-5 coins. Accept either CSV string ('bitcoin,ethereum,solana') or array (['bitcoin','ethereum','solana']).

name: crypto_compare
